title: Review Handoff And Findings
description: Measure whether an agent can review a handoff, separate actionable findings from notes, and choose the correct Zenith mutation.
prompt: Review the current handoff. Identify any actionable correctness issues, decide whether the phase can advance, and specify which Zenith command should record the result.
setup: Create a plan with a phase ready for review.
Record a recent session summary that names changed files.
Optionally seed one open medium finding to test triage.
successCriteria: Leads with actionable findings or clearly says there are none.
Does not record speculative nits as findings.
Uses relatedPlanId and relatedPhaseId when a finding should be recorded.
Advances the phase only when review is clean.
privacyRules: Do not store full model transcripts.
Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, or full diffs in benchmark records.
Record only scenario id, variant, timestamps, and evaluator-entered scores.

metrics.label: Finding quality
metrics.description: Evaluator score from 1 to 5 for actionable, deduplicated findings.

metrics.label: Safe advance decision
metrics.description: Whether the response chooses phase advancement only when appropriate.
